{{Quote|Soldiers are often more trouble than they're worth. You deserve better from your opponents.|Darth Acharon|<ref name="Government Clearance" />}}
'''Darth Acharon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who served as one of the twelve [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]] on the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Trained as a [[Sith Warrior]], Acharon controlled the [[Sphere of Biotic Science]] within the Empire and was universally despised by the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] for his zero-tolerance policy on incompetence. During the [[Galactic War]] with the Republic, Acharon was sent to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to oversee the [[Battle of Corellia]], and he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a Republic strike team while defending the [[Ion Wall]] weapon in the [[Governmental Sector|Government District]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|One of them, Darth Acharon, was dispatched to Intra-Corellian Intelligence to keep the Ion Wall safe. You'll have to get past him.|Cole Cantarus|<ref name="Government Clearance" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] trained as a [[Sith Warrior]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Acharon had ascended to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire's]] ruling [[Dark Council]] by the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Government Clearance" /> As a Dark Councilor, Acharon headed the [[Sphere of Biotic Science]], one of the twelve [[Spheres of Influence]] within the Empire, and in that position he oversaw the branches of the Empire that dealt in medical science, [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] augmentation and physical enhancement&mdash;often in conjunction with [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] and [[Sith sorcery/Legends|magic]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> During his career as a Dark Councilor, Acharon quickly became known for his views on incompetence among the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]]. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] zero-tolerance policy regarding failure led him to personally [[Death/Legends|execute]] over two hundred soldiers throughout his tenure, regardless of whether the soldiers had failed critical missions or simply worn their uniforms incorrectly. Those officers and troopers who volunteered to serve under him received even more detrimental treatment at Acharon's hands, as the Dark Councilor despised sycophants as well.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Darth Acharon}}</ref>

[[File:DarthAcharon01.jpg|thumb|left|190px|Darth Acharon in the Intra-Corellian Intelligence building]]
In [[3640 BBY]], Acharon and fellow Dark Councilor [[Darth Hadra]] traveled to the contested [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to reinforce [[Darth Decimus]],<ref name="Government Clearance" /> head of the [[Sphere of Military Strategy]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> in the war effort there.<ref name="Government Clearance" /> During the [[Battle of Corellia]], Darth Acharon attended an eventful meeting of the Dark Council on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. The meeting was originally called by [[Darth Baras]], who attempted to declare himself the [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Voice of the Emperor]] to the rest of the Council, a position that would have granted Baras control over the entire Empire&mdash;but the Dark Councilor was [[Duel in the Dark Council Chambers (Galactic War)|killed]] by his [[Empire's Wrath|former apprentice]], the newly appointed [[Emperor's Wrath]]. Along with the rest of the Council, Acharon acknowledged the Wrath's autonomy and the fact that the Sith Warrior served a [[Tenebrae|power greater]] than the Council's one.<ref name="Retribution">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Retribution|Korriban}}</ref> After the Wrath departed, Acharon's fellow Dark Councilor [[Darth Thanaton]] revealed another matter before the council: he appealed to the other Councilors to destroy his rival and subordinate [[Darth Nox|Lord Kallig]], though the two [[Duel in the Dark Council Chambers (Kaggath)|dueled]] when the Council refused to fight Thanaton's battles. Acharon watched from Corellia as Kallig defeated Thanaton, and the Dark Councilors present on Korriban rewarded the young Sith with Thanaton's seat on the Dark Council.<ref name="The Dark Council">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|The Dark Council|Korriban}}</ref>

In the later stages of the battle, Acharon remained in the [[Governmental Sector|Government District]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] to guard the [[Ion Wall]], a powerful weapon that could disable all electronics across a wide area. [[Cole Cantarus]], an officer in the [[Corellian Security Force]], briefly encountered Acharon during his time gathering information on the Imperial occupation forces. Cantarus' info, combined with the help of Councilor [[Belos]]&mdash;a member of Corellia's ruling [[Corellian Council|Council]]&mdash;allowed the Republic to learn the location of the Ion Wall's transmitters and direct them at the [[Legislature Building]] instead of Republic forces. A Republic strike team then stormed the [[Intra-Corellian Intelligence]] building to reach the Ion Wall's controls, cutting through the Imperial soldiers that Acharon had stationed in the building. As the strike team reached the weapon's control room, Acharon decided to execute the officer in charge of defending the building because of his failure and [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force choke|choked]] the commander to death with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] before tossing the man's body across the room as a display of his power. The Sith Lord then questioned the invaders as to the identity of their spy, but when the strike team refused to answer Acharon drew his [[Color/Legends|red]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and attacked. However, the Dark Councilor was ultimately no match for the combined strength of the strike team, and the Dark Councilor was struck down in battle with the Republic fighters.<ref name="Government Clearance" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Acharon_strangles_someone.png|thumb|right|210px|Darth Acharon executes a subordinate as a result of their incompetence]]
A Human male with orange [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and extensive [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] enhancements, Darth Acharon's pale skin was turned ashen gray on most of his face by the corrupting effects of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. The Sith Lord was famous for his extremely cruel views on failure and sycophants, and he had no qualms about killing soldiers who failed him in any way. Acharon also despised subordinates who attempted to gain favor with him, treating them with the same disgust that he did incompetents.<ref name="Government Clearance" />

==Powers and abilities==
Darth Acharon trained as a Sith Warrior and became proficient in both [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] and the use of the Force, skills that eventually led to his appointment to the Dark Council. He utilized both a single red-bladed lightsaber and offensive [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] in battle, and his body was heavily augmented with cybernetic implants.<ref name="Government Clearance" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Acharon first appeared in "Government Clearance", the final mission in the Republic storyline on Corellia in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]]. Players confront him in an attempt to take control of the Ion Wall weapon, and he is killed in battle.<ref name="Government Clearance" /> The [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' identified Acharon as the head of the Sphere of Biotic Science.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
